messages:
olivia: Kicking off staged wave for release `rw-core@1.4.2` -> gradually shift traffic to model variant `rw-1.4.2-quant` (start 3% to 30% over 2h). Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Release notes: https://go/redwood/release/1.4.2 (brief: perf fixes, small tokenizer change).

mike: thanks. who has the go/no-go for infra? ops-oncall?

ops-oncall: I can take infra + SRE for the next 2h. monitoring dashboards up. watch `embed-latency` and `v1-generate-5xx`.

olivia: deploy-bot will do progressive shift, I set policy: `5xx_rate>0.5% for 5m -> pause`, `latency_p95>1200ms for 10m -> pause`.

deploy-bot: [automated] starting rollout: 3% traffic -> rw-1.4.2-quant in eu-west/us-west. expected warmup per shard ~90s.

sanjay: quick FYI from canary logs: seeing small uptick in KV cache evictions on a subset of pods in eu-west-1a. Eviction rate ~1.2x baseline. Not yet materialized in user 5xxs.

lucy: tagging in memory lead — evictions correlate with sequences >1024 in our synthetic. Can we throttle long-seq routes to the old variant while we triage?

olivia: yes, applying temporary route pin for `seq>1024` -> `rw-1.3.9` (old stable) now. command: `rdw deploy traffic-pin --route seq>1024 --version rw-1.3.9`

deploy-bot: [automated] traffic pin applied for route `seq>1024` -> rw-1.3.9. Updated routing table.

mike: good move. metrics? any 5xx spike yet?

sanjay: 5xx stayed flat, p95 for generate increased by ~80ms in eu-west but normalized after pin. continuing to observe kvcache churn on ~5 pods, digging into GC logs.

nora: ops, if churn persists recommend hold at 3% and run a targeted smoke on longer sequences before advancing. I can run a small eval suite in 10 min.

ops-oncall: agree — hold at 3% for now. please alert if tests fail.

olivia: holding advance. will not move to 10% until we get smoke pass. everyone, if no objections, we keep pinned routing for long sequences and update release notes with the temporary mitigation.

lucy: no objections. I'll follow up with a short postmortem note if we find a regression path.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout paused at 3% due to manual hold by olivia. active pins: seq>1024->rw-1.3.9.

olivia: action items: 1) sanjay to post GC traces + small heap profiles (ETA 20m). 2) nora to run long-seq eval (ETA 12m). 3) lucy to craft communications for CS (ETA 30m). If evals clear we re-open traffic shift with 10% warmup and watch for kvcache.

mike: thumbs up. thanks all. :thumbsup:
